entity: Diamondback's Texas fracking chemical rows hidden as trade secrets, vs the statewide rate
what_we_add: Diamondback's company-wide rate: 30.3% of its rows, secrets in 96.7% of 3,164 jobs. Open-FF only shows one Diamondback well (63%) and the statewide 16.3%.
why: Open-FF names Diamondback concealing chemical identities as trade secrets and gives the statewide 16.3% (our 16.2%) — same entity, same finding, same direction. Our company-level rate and job counts are countable and nowhere stated.
